snippet.title: 3D First-Person Psychological Horror "Dread Neighbor" Steam Page Released
snippet.description:
Being Watched & Progressive Loop Horror
"Dread Neighbor"
3D First-person Modern Chinese Psychological Horror Game
brought by ghostcase (developer of Dread Flats)

You rent a remote, cheap apartment to save money.
Life feels normal, until an inescapable gaze starts to seep into everything.
As spaces subtly change, you drift further from the ordinary, inching toward a twisted murder truth.

Fear doesn’t strike all at once—
it’s been watching you the whole time.
